scope: Targeted primary-source formula-level duplication comparison plus AI-assisted independent rederivations and computational audits; not an exhaustive proof of publication priority and not human peer review.
direct_duplicate_criteria: Same parameterization by one product of L linear forms
Fully repeated-factor collapsed point, including the singular factor fiber
Wick/top-chaos or ordinary Gaussian teacher-student population metric
Full signed factor-coordinate spectrum with exact coefficients and multiplicities
A notation substitution sufficient to recover the inertia formulas without a new permanent/Isserlis calculation
